$comment: Advisories that npm audit reports against an installed version but that cannot reach this
codebase. Checked by scripts/check_js_audit.py in the `Dependency audit` job; see ADR-0017.
An entry is a written, dated argument, not a mute button: the build fails on any advisory
with no entry, on any entry past its review_by, and on any entry that matches nothing in
today's report. Every field is required, and unknown fields are refused.

allow.reason: CSRF in react-router's RSC Mode (CWE-352, 'action execution before 400 response'). The 'action' is a server-side react-router action, and apps/web has no server: it is a static SPA built by `vite build`, and its only router usage is declarative (BrowserRouter/Routes/Route/Link/NavLink/useNavigate/useParams/MemoryRouter). There is no createBrowserRouter, no data router, no loader or action, and zero @react-router/* packages in the lockfile — RSC Mode requires @react-router/dev plus a server runtime, neither of which is installed. There is also no fixed release on the 7.x line: 7.18.1 is the latest, the vulnerable range runs to 8.2.0, and npm's only offer is a downgrade to 7.11.0. Revisit when react-router 8.3 is reachable, or sooner if apps/web ever adopts a data router or a server runtime.
